subject: Follow-up: Token pricing scenarios & draft invoice for OptiHealth
short_summary: Post-demo follow-up to confirm monthly token volumes, target unit economics, and deliver draft invoice + pricing model. Customer agreed on three usage scenarios; requested a formal estimate for procurement and PO timeline.
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Andrea Gomez <andrea@optihealth.com>
Cc: sergio_alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-12T15:10:00-07:00
Subject: Follow-up & pricing scenarios from today's call

Hi Andrea — thanks for the time today. Quick recap and agreed next steps: 

- Volumes: OptiHealth expects three ramp scenarios we discussed: Pilot (2M tokens/month), Growth (12M tokens/month), Scale (65M tokens/month). Customer confirmed these are monthly active token estimates, averaged over 6 months.
- Budget: target range across teams is $800–$1,200 / 1M tokens for the Pilot, $600–$850 / 1M tokens for Growth, and target blended $400–$550 / 1M at Scale (with reserved capacity). You mentioned procurement is comfortable approving a short PO for the pilot.
- Unit economics: we reviewed on-call model selection tradeoffs (higher-accuracy model vs quantized variant). We highlighted Redwood's tiered unit pricing + dedicated-reserve discount for >50M/mo.

Attachments I'm sending: a draft invoice estimate and our pricing calculator (both attached) — these include token-by-token line items, projected monthly spend, and a suggested reserved capacity commit to hit your target $/1M numbers.

Next steps: 
1) I'll share the draft invoice + pricing calc now (attached).
2) Andrea, if you can confirm which scenario you'd like quoted (Pilot vs Growth vs Scale) and a PO owner, we'll produce a procurement-ready invoice and signature link.
3) Sergio/Vanessa — please review the reserve-commit discount assumptions and the recommended fallback policy (auto-route to quantized model during peak) before I send to procurement.

If helpful I can also export a one-page cost breakdown for your CFO that shows blended $/1M under different cache/batch settings.

Thanks — rachel

--
Rachel Kim
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0182

From: Andrea Gomez <andrea@optihealth.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: OptiHealth Finance <finance@optihealth.com>
Date: 2026-08-13T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up & pricing scenarios from today's call

Thanks Rachel — this looks good and matches our notes. A couple clarifications before we route to procurement: 

- The 12M number is likely our baseline for Q4 (Growth). Pilot will be a hard cap at 2M for the first 30 days. Scale (65M) is a 12–18 month target depending on adoption.
- Our budget owner wants to see two items: (a) a line showing "effective $/1M tokens" after cache and batching assumptions, and (b) the delta vs standard hosted API rate if we do a 12-month reserved commit.

Can you confirm the effective $/1M for the Growth scenario using the recommended cache settings (prefix caching enabled for 30% hit rate) and the conservative quantized model fallback for spikes? Also, is the reserved commitment modeled as a straight monthly credit or as a per-token discount in your calc?

If you can get the procurement-ready invoice + a one-page CFO summary by EOD Monday (Aug 16), we can start the PO and loop finance.

Best,
Andrea

--
Andrea Gomez
Director, AI Integrations
OptiHealth
andrea@optihealth.com | +1 212-555-0199

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Andrea Gomez <andrea@optihealth.com>
Cc: sergio_alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-16T14:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up & pricing scenarios from today's call — draft invoice + calc attached

Andrea — attaching the updated artifacts per your ask: 

Attachments: 20260812_optih_health_token_pricing.xlsx (contains scenario tabs: Pilot / Growth / Scale; includes cache-hit assumptions, batching latency SLO tradeoffs, and blended effective $/1M) and redwood_pricing_calc_v3.xlsx (our internal pricing calculator with reserved-commit modeling).

Quick answers in-line: 
- Effective $/1M (Growth, 12M tokens/mo): $675 / 1M tokens (this assumes 30% prefix cache hit, small-batch optimization, and a conservative 10% of tokens served on quantized fallback during daily peaks).
- Reserved commitment: modeled as a blended per-token discount applied to your committed volume (not a monthly credit). The spreadsheet shows both approaches; the recommended commercial is a per-token step discount once you cross the reserved thresholds.

Invoice summary (draft): 
- Pilot (2M): $1,430 (all-in estimate including data egress & logging) — listed as a 30-day one-off PO line.
- Growth (12M): $8,100 / month (blended) based on effective $675 / 1M.
- Scale (65M): $28,350 / month (with 12-month reserved commit and burst policy) — shows additional savings if you commit to 12 months.

I've also included a one-page CFO summary within the first tab of the OptiHealth workbook. Please validate the PO owner and I'll prepare the DocuSign-ready invoice.

Sergio / Vanessa — flagging two items for legal and finance review before I send DocuSign: 1) the reserved-commit cancellation window and 2) the SLA credit language for latency SLOs under heavy burst.

Thanks — Rachel

--
Rachel Kim
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference

From: Andrea Gomez <andrea@optihealth.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, OptiHealth Finance <finance@optihealth.com>
Date: 2026-08-18T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up & pricing scenarios from today's call — draft invoice + calc attached

Rachel — this is great, thanks. Confirming next steps from our side: 

- Procurement will issue a PO for the Pilot (2M) this week. PO owner: Claudia Rivera (claudia.rivera@optihealth.com). Expect PO number by Thu Aug 20.
- For the Growth scenario, finance likes the effective $675 / 1M you modeled. We'll likely request a 6-month reserved commit to start (not a full 12) — can you provide a short note in the invoice that covers a 6-month term and the associated breakpoint?
- Please send the DocuSign invoice for the Pilot only (2M) so procurement can sign quickly. We'll treat the Growth as a separate deal annex once the PO is in place.

Looping Claudia into this thread now (she's on finance). If you need anything from me to speed procurement, let me know — thanks to you and the team.

Best,
Andrea

--
Andrea Gomez
Director, AI Integrations
OptiHealth

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: sergio_alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-18T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: OptiHealth PO for Pilot — action items

Quick internal note after Andrea's confirmation: 

- Action 1 (Sergio): please review the attached "redwood_pricing_calc_v3.xlsx" and confirm the 6-month reserved-commit breakpoint language. Legal will want the exact phrasing for the invoice annex. Can you also confirm the SLA credit % for latency miss we should propose for the Pilot?
- Action 2 (Vanessa): please prep a DocuSign invoice for the Pilot (2M) with Claudia Rivera as the PO owner (claudia.rivera@optihealth.com). Use the Pilot line item $1,430 and include a one-line note describing the 6-month reserved-commit option for Growth (we're not asking them to sign it now).
- Timeline: Claudia expects PO by Thu Aug 20 — aim to have DocuSign out Wed 8/19 EOD.

If either of you foresee any blockers, flag now and I'll escalate.

Thanks — rachel
